originality.rationale: The primary cycle face classification of Kuehne--Monin identifies triangular and quadrilateral faces and gives counts but not the standard-metric planar area multiplicity multiset. The new theorem derives seven distinct irrational triangle areas, every exact multiplicity and an asymptotic concentration statement; the founding definition and the combinatorial criterion are explicitly credited. Actual indexed-record searches for area spectra and equivalent metric formulations located no equivalent evaluated claim; absence of such hits is not proof of global novelty. An accessible earlier graph-reconstruction theorem using full squared vertex distance data in principle allows algorithmic reconstruction but does not provide this exact closed classification.
